row.name: Digi International Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=35 breakdowns=2 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.76 tightness=0.85 base_volume_vs_leg=1.13 base_volume_vs_avg=1.01
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 35 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 2 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 0.76 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 2.4% vs its 20-SMA, 9.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Three recorded check failures — C (35-session base with 2 breakdowns and 0.76 giveback), RE (burst bar only 54% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume 59% of prior session, only at the 50-day average, rank 23 of 60) — collectively undermine the setup's quality. The base shaded on the chart visually confirms the problem: it spans from mid-August through early October with wide, overlapping bars and a clear dip to ~$70 before recovering, showing two distinct breakdown episodes rather than a tight, orderly consolidation. The signal bar itself closes near its high but the range expansion is absent and volume is weak, making this a low-conviction burst.
claude.key_risk: The 35-session base gave back 76% of the prior leg with two 4% breakdowns inside it, meaning there is significant trapped supply overhead from buyers who entered during the August peak near $84–$85.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps below the signal day's close of $75.21 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest with volume tracking below the prior session's pace.
